club.en: Our school has more than ten different clubs.
club.cn: 我们学校有十多个不同的社团。

join.en: Why don't you join the science club this term?
join.cn: 你为什么不这学期加科学社？

robot.en: Our team built a robot that can walk and dance.
robot.cn: 我们队造了一个会走会跳的机器人。

chess.en: Chess teaches us to think two steps ahead.

photo.en: I take photos of every season in the school garden.
photo.cn: 我在校园里拍下每个季节的照片。

drama.en: The drama club is putting on a play next month.
drama.cn: 戏剧社下个月要演一出戏。

meet.en: The chess club members meet in Room 5 after school.
meet.cn: 国际象棋社成员放学后在 5 号教室集合。

interest.en: A real interest can grow into a lifelong hobby.
interest.cn: 真正的兴趣能变成一辈子的爱好。
